Urban Planning / Mixed Programme · New Shillong, Meghalaya

New Shillong

A city-scale framework supported by proposals for housing, mobility, work and recreation. The portfolio follows the work from the road and landscape structure into individual buildings and residential typologies.

Location
New Shillong, Meghalaya
Category
Urban Planning / Mixed Programme
Design role
